description: Leo app browser: Load a URL in the browser and wait for the page to finish loading. Only http, https and about:blank are allowed. This drives the browser pane in the user's Leo app, not a headless or Playwright browser: the user can watch it live and take over. Each agent has its own tabs and persistent cookies and logins. On a remote machine, localhost URLs reach that machine's own ports through a forward Leo sets up.
